# Game compatibility

<!-- Generated from patches/<Game>/game.ini by tools/dev/gen-compatibility.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

This list shows what has been tried so far, on one setup (a Steam Deck with a PS Move ZCM1 and a PS3 Eye). It is a snapshot, not a promise: arcade games differ a lot, and some depend on the TeknoParrot runtime or on your own dump.
RavenGun ships no games. You need your own legally obtained copies.

## Working (39)

These games run on RavenGun's own loader and start straight from RavenGun (double-click), without TeknoParrot; they were played with the lightgun (PS Move or mouse) and checked on the TV. The note says what was tested.

- **After Dark**: WORKING via double-click in the app (2026-10-15): attract with movie, coin, START, two stages (Silent Valley, Castle of Shadows), continue, score 69000; played 5.5 min in mouse mode. Recipe: rg-compat (DirectInput with a NULL HINSTANCE), Gst32 + data/wmv-asyncreader.reg (movie), DXVK + Microsoft d3dx9_41 (without those the world renders black), gamescope. Open: the owner heard audio hitches in the first run (wined3d); not re-checked after DXVK.
- **Bug Busters**: WORKING (2026-10-15): double-click in RavenGun, rg-direct with the 32-bit GStreamer from Proton ([Launch] Gst32, docs/gst32.md) for the MPEG-1 videos; without it the game died after MODE SELECT. Played 5.5 min in mouse mode. Runs in a window (taskbar visible).
- **Drakons Realm Keepers**: WORKING on our own route (2026-10-14): double-click in RavenGun, no TeknoParrotUi (rg-direct, Wine, tp-shm I/O bridge with the WartranTroopers layout). Measured with the test pattern: coin (key 5), START (key 1), world select, aim and shoot, CONTINUE, score 400; more than 5 min. Not yet played with the real Move.

## Playable (5)

These games start from RavenGun and can be played with the lightgun. Some are not yet confirmed with a real PS Move in every detail; the note says what was tested.

- **Gashaaaan Refill!!!!**: Playable after a one-time setup in the test menu (clock, screen, free play; now stored in the game's save data). Then start, aiming and trigger (the ball) work. Test menu: key 0, select with start, execute with P1 aux1.
- **Go Go Strike**: Works: bowling with the Move as trackball (direction and swing set the throw), start (key 1) and trigger (click). 4:3 picture with black bars (gamescope).
- **Luigi's Mansion Arcade**: Starts by double-click in RavenGun (2026-10-14): on our own OpenParrot core and through gamescope the game runs full screen in attract (with the closed core it stopped after ~13 s). Measured earlier: ~6 min of continuous attract/demo on our core (BEWIJS-5MIN.md), with the drop-in rg-pe-hook.dll (see MECHANISME-PE-HOOK.md). NOT playable yet: coin and TEST do not reach the game (DIRECT-ROUTE-INVOER.md).
- **Pigs Might Fly**: Playable: start (key 1) and trigger (the lever that launches the pig) work; portrait picture in the middle of the TV. Test menu: TEST (key 0), service (F3). Runs in its own Wine prefix where C:\Sega points at the game.
- **Time Crisis 5**: Playable through the I/O bridge (shared memory): aiming, trigger and left pedal (middle button) work; coin = the Move button for key 5 (the engine sends Shift+T to the game). Shoot '1-player solo' in the menu. The right pedal has not been checked on its own yet.

## Not tested yet (22)

These games are set up, but nobody has tried them with the lightgun yet.

- **3D Cosplay Mahjong**: Never started and impossible to plan: the game is not on the NAS, so there is no game map, no file evidence and no start measurement (--plan stops with rc=4, "game not found"). The profile names no dongle, but that was not measured against the game.
- **Aliens Armageddon**: Never started. Statically prepared for the native route (2026-10-14): i386, unpacked, own loader (rg-elfloader: /usr/lib/libcsv.so by basename), RIO board through the bridge without encryption (addresses measured with objdump, same report as Jurassic Park). Open: (1) the HASP dongle is static and classic (aksusbd/NetHASP, like Terminator; BESCHERMING-STATUS.md): expect "DongleInitialize() FAILED" until there is a hasp-haken.ini or a daemon route; (2) aim through the IR cameras in the guns (cmgr/FTDI) is not emulated; (3) the switch ids are taken from Jurassic Park.
- **Aliens Extermination**: Never started: only a static study of the protection (BESCHERMING-STATUS.md). Aliens Extermination (Global VR): 32-bit Windows PE with a statically linked HASP4 dongle and a USB HID check.
- **America's Army Arcade**: Never started. Statically examined (2026-10-14): i386, unpacked, Unreal Engine 2 (armyops-bin, SDL 1.2 from the game folder, libstdc++.so.5 from ElfLdr2/libs). Input through SDL (X mouse and keyboard). Open: START is F1 and coin is C in the game, the daemon sends 1 and 5; the virtual lightgun does not move the X cursor (LIBINPUT_IGNORE_DEVICE), so aiming only works with a physical mouse.
- **Block King Ball Shooter**: Prepared, not run (pass 1, Type-X PC Based): profile, identification and input route are in place; nothing has been measured yet.
- **Coopers's 9**: Prepared, not run (pass 1, KONAMI PC Based): profile, identification and input route are in place; nothing has been measured yet.
- **Crossfire: Maximum Paintball**: Never started. Statically examined (2026-10-14): i386, unpacked, small (med_pball 161 kB). I/O through I/O ports (iopl, inb/outb; "/dev/p37c must exist or user must be root") and the guns through the kernel driver /dev/mjg; neither exists natively. Needed: a shim that lets iopl succeed and emulates the port instructions (SIGSEGV), and a fake /dev/mjg. Same engine as Police Trainer 2.
- **Elevator Action Death Parade**: Profile from the TeknoParrot template (2026-10-15). Measured: runs (~55% CPU) in gamescope, 1920x1080 window, but black; never opens the JVS pipe and prints no debug strings (same pattern as Gaia Attack 4). English texts present. Open.
- **Far Cry Paradise Lost**: Started 2026-10-15: without gamescope and at 1920x1080 it gets past the window and mode-switch hangs and creates its D3D9 device, but it draws nothing (black, no Present). Suspected: waiting on its dongle (HASP) or USB IO. See [Display].
- **Friction**: 2026-10-15: black under gamescope (UpdateWindow spins forever); without gamescope loading screens, then black at 7 fps. See [Display].
- **Gunslinger Stratos 3**: Never started: only a static study of the protection (BESCHERMING-STATUS.md). Gunslinger Stratos 3 (Taito, 64-bit Windows): the protection is NESYS (HTTPS with a client certificate).
- **Lost Land Adventure**: Never started: only a static study of the protection (BESCHERMING-STATUS.md). Lost Land Adventure (Namco ES3X, 64-bit Windows): same dongle runtime as Time Crisis 5; RSLauncher also uses hasp_write.
- **Mighty Moto**: Prepared, not run (pass 1, UNIS PC Based, Unity 32-bit): identification only; there is no TeknoParrot template, no input layout, and the local SmartFoxServer needs its own start. Nothing measured.
- **Police Trainer 2**: Never started. Statically examined (2026-10-14): i386, unpacked, two programs (pt2s_g11 and the sound program pt2snd.f7, which TeknoParrot starts first). I/O through I/O ports (iopl; "port must be 37c") and the guns through the kernel driver /dev/mjg (light pulses), like Crossfire: Maximum Paintball. Open: as Crossfire, plus two programs in one sandbox.
- **Robin Hood**: Prepared, not run (pass 1, ICE PC Based): profile, identification and input route are in place; nothing has been measured yet.
- **Sega Game Shell**: Never started: only a static study of the protection (BESCHERMING-STATUS.md). Sega Game Shell (NAS folder Sega): the dump is Transformers: Shadows Rising, shell build 180605; the dongle scan fails but does not block.
- **Tank! Tank! Tank!**: Never started and impossible to plan: the game is not on the NAS, so there is no game map, no file evidence and no start measurement (--plan stops with rc=4, "game not found"). The profile names no dongle, but that was not measured against the game.
- **The House of the Dead 4**: Never started. Lindbergh route ready (2026-10-14, docs/lindbergh.md): the folder 'The House of the Dead 4' is Rev C (hod4M.elf, game ID 0xe213414d, clean ELF), NOT the Special; the library currently links that folder to HOTD4SP and must point it to HOTD4. Static study of the protection: BESCHERMING-STATUS.md.
- **The House of the Dead 4 Special**: Measured 2026-10-15 (Lindbergh route, stackalign, /var/tmp): double-click, ride reset with START, then more than 5 min of attract without a crash. Coin and START do not start a game: the ride version most likely waits for seat signals (seat belts, the ride's start button; lindbergh-loader's rideBoard.c). Not playable yet.
- **TNXK0O~C (unidentified Sega title)**: Never started: only a static study of the protection (BESCHERMING-STATUS.md). TNXK0O~C: unidentified Sega title (keychip Ver.1.12, SDDV_Table.dat, RingWide); the game's name is inferred, not established.
- **Transformers: Human Alliance**: Profile from the TeknoParrot template (2026-10-15). Measured: in gamescope (Windowed 0) and with a 1920x1080 Wine virtual desktop the exe runs (~60% CPU) but stays black and never opens the JVS pipe (2+ min). Open.
- **Walking Dead**: Never started. Statically examined (2026-10-14): i386, HASPE-packed like Jurassic Park (807 first-PLT stubs with 0xdeadbeef, GOT bound on the cabinet; game_ori is the envelope). ## Not working yet (5)

These games do not start, or are blocked by something RavenGun does not work around (for example copy protection). They are listed so you know what to expect; they may start working in a later version.

- **Ghostbusters**: The ElfLdr2 path check is solved. The loader requires all files of this game to be in a folder named pm (the Play Mechanix install root) with the path to the elf inside it; with [Identify] Path = pm/game and a view folder views/GhostBusters/pm with links to the game files it continues to "Starting Game". The game does not reach a picture yet; what blocks it then (dongle, OpenGL context) has not been measured. The pm folder is not a drop-in: its content is the owner's own dump (2.7 GB), see README.md.
- **Haunted Museum**: Does not start yet: no picture. The Wine crash (MXCSR=0 caused by the loader) is worked around (RG_LOADER_FPFIX); the game runs through the JVS chain but stays black (no 0x20 polling). Parked; see games-status.md, eleventh round.
- **Haunted Museum II**: Does not start yet: no picture. The Wine crash (MXCSR=0 caused by the loader) is worked around (RG_LOADER_FPFIX); the game runs through the JVS chain but stays black (no 0x20 polling). Parked; see games-status.md, eleventh round.
- **Infinity Blade FX**: Does not start yet: UE3 starts (needs Wine Mono and a first-run dialog for TeknoParrot.dll), then a white or black picture; the log stops at 'Kaboom: InitLib() failed'. Parked.
- **Men in Black**: Under investigation since 2026-10-14; see ATTRACT-RUN.md.
